# Message Boards This guide will explain how Message Boards and Direct Messages can be used to communicate across the entire sector.
## Message Board Consoles Message Board Consoles are used to communicate across the sector. Every console shows the same message board, so a thread posted at one console can be read from any other. Message Board Consoles can be built with a machine board from a circuit imprinter.
## Threads Press 'Create A New Entry' to post a new thread with a title, a message and a category. The categories are [bold]General[/bold], [bold]Faction Recruiting[/bold], [bold]Buy Requests[/bold], [bold]Sell Offers[/bold] and [bold]Events[/bold].
[bold]Each character can only create one thread every 4 hours[/bold], so make it count.
Press 'View' on a thread to read it and add comments. Comments can be posted once every 5 seconds. You can delete your own threads and comments at any time.
### Notifications Message Board Consoles will announce out loud whenever a new thread or comment is posted. Press 'Mute Notifications' to silence a console.
## Direct Messages Direct messages can be sent to any character by name from a Message Board Console using 'Compose Message'. The recipient is notified immediately wherever they are.
Your conversations can be read at any time through the 'Messages' tab of the [bold]Job Network Menu[/bold], but replying requires a Message Board Console.
